title: Ringed-site pullback preserves finite local bases
statement: Let C,D be finite-limit categories with Grothendieck topologies J,K and F:C→D a continuous, cover-preserving, finite-limit-preserving functor. Let R and S be ring sheaves and a:R→F_*S a ringed-site map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume the module pullback adjunction exists and abelian sheafification with locally-bijective characterization exists on all slice sites, in the stated common coefficient universe. If an R-module M is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], then its ordinary ringed pullback a^*M is finite locally free. Ranks may vary and may be zero.

source.place: Lemma local-pullback, Tag 03DO(2); localization of morphisms of ringed sites, Tag 04J0.

proof.text: Choose a covering family of finite free trivializations of M. Cover preservation and preservation of the terminal object show that their F-images still cover the terminal object.

Localize the ringed-site map at each chosen object. The local comparison identifies restriction of global pullback with localized pullback. Use the universe-polymorphic existence theorem for its adjoint. Pull back the free trivialization; Mathlib pullbackObjFreeIso identifies its image with the free module on the same finite set. The image cover and those isomorphisms establish finite local freeness.

theorem finiteLocallyFree_pullback
    {C D : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {F : C ⥤ D} [F.IsContinuous J K] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v w}} {S : Sheaf K RingCat.{max u v w}}
    (a : R ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj S)
    [(pushforward.{max u v w} a).IsRightAdjoint]
    (hc : CoverPreserving J K F)
    [∀ V, HasSheafify (J.over V) Ab.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V, (J.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective Ab.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V, HasSheafify (K.over V) Ab.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V, (K.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective Ab.{max u v w}]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{max u v w} R) [hM : M.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ((pullback a).obj M).IsFiniteLocallyFree
